title: SwingVision Match Quality Baseline Drift Alert
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swingvision:session
| timechart span=1d avg(shot_quality_score) as metric
| eventstats avg(metric) as base, stdev(metric) as sd
| eval delta=round(metric-base,2), drift=if(abs(delta)>2*sd,1,0)
| where drift=1
description: Flags days where swingvision match quality moved far away from your recent baseline instead of staying within normal variation.
value: Large baseline drift is a quick way to surface bad days, breakout days, or sensor issues without waiting for a coach's manual review.
implementation: Schedule this daily after ingesting swingvision match quality events and investigate any drift days alongside notes about fatigue, travel, or conditions.
visualization: Timechart of daily shot quality score with baseline and drift markers.
grandmaExplanation: It watches when swingvision match quality suddenly looks very different from your normal pattern.
